description: Cross-skill routing evals for ERP-linked environments. Each test checks that a natural Finance and Operations request loads the specialist skill and selects the ERP-capable surface rather than applying Dataverse-only tools.
defaultAssertions: PRIORITY_2: FIRST_ATTEMPT: Agent recognized the ERP context and routed directly to the correct specialist skill and managed surface.

tests.prompt: Show me the first ten Finance and Operations sales orders.
tests.expected_response: The request routes through dv-query to ERP MCP or dataverse data query --target erp. It does not use DataverseClient, FetchXML, SQL, PAC, or erp-xpp.
tests.description: Route an ERP business-data read to dv-query.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-overview
PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-query
PRIORITY_1: The agent uses ERP MCP or dataverse data query --target erp with a bounded top value.
PRIORITY_1: It does not load erp-xpp or use the Python Dataverse SDK, FetchXML, SQL, or PAC for the ERP record read.

tests.prompt: Create one customer group in Finance and Operations for USMF.
tests.expected_response: The request routes through dv-data. The agent asks for missing field values and target confirmation, then uses ERP MCP or dataverse data create --target erp; it does not use Dataverse CreateMultiple or erp-xpp.
tests.description: Route a small ERP business-data write to dv-data.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-overview
PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-data
PRIORITY_1: The agent does not write until the customer-group ID, description, linked ERP target, and user confirmation are available.
PRIORITY_1: The planned surface is ERP MCP or dataverse data create --target erp with dataAreaId; it is not the Dataverse Python SDK or erp-xpp.

tests.prompt: Show me the fields and keys exposed by the Finance and Operations SalesOrderHeaders entity.
tests.expected_response: Runtime ERP entity schema routes to dv-query and dataverse data describe --target erp. It does not route to Dataverse metadata creation APIs or X++ authoring.
tests.description: Route ERP runtime schema inspection away from dv-metadata.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-overview
PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-query
PRIORITY_1: The trajectory uses dataverse data describe --target erp --table SalesOrderHeaders.
PRIORITY_1: It does not use Dataverse MetadataService, client.tables, solution metadata, or erp-xpp for runtime ERP entity inspection.

tests.prompt: Show me the latest batch jobs in Finance and Operations.
tests.expected_response: The request routes to dv-admin and dataverse erp batch list. It does not use generic ERP OData CRUD, Python, or erp-xpp.
tests.description: Route ERP batch administration to dv-admin.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-overview
PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-admin
PRIORITY_1: The trajectory uses a bounded dataverse erp batch list command.
PRIORITY_1: It does not query BatchJobs through Python, generic Dataverse data tools, PAC, or erp-xpp.

tests.prompt: Build and deploy the X++ models in this repository to my Finance and Operations development environment.
tests.expected_response: The request routes to erp-xpp and PAC's ERP package lifecycle. The agent inspects the project, confirms the environment and modes, compiles with pac package compile --package-type erp, then deploys with pac package deploy --package-type erp. It does not use Dataverse solution ALM, ERP OData, or DMF.
tests.description: Route X++ source lifecycle to erp-xpp.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-overview
PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: erp-xpp
PRIORITY_1: The agent uses pac package compile --package-type erp and pac package deploy --package-type erp after the required project inspection and target/mode confirmation.
PRIORITY_1: It does not use pac solution import, ERP OData, DMF, the Python Dataverse SDK, or raw HTTP to build or deploy X++.

tests.prompt: Set up Finance and Operations MCP for the ERP environment linked to my current Dataverse profile.
tests.expected_response: The request routes to dv-connect. The agent detects erpUrl from the selected Dataverse environment, configures the proper ERP MCP transport, preserves existing servers, and requires restart rather than claiming immediate availability.
tests.description: Route ERP MCP setup to dv-connect.
assertions: PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-overview
PRIORITY_1: SKILL_LOADED: dv-connect
PRIORITY_1: The agent obtains erpUrl from the current Dataverse linkage and configures direct HTTP at <erpUrl>/mcp or an stdio proxy receiving the base <erpUrl>.
PRIORITY_1: It preserves existing MCP servers, requires host restart/reload, and does not claim tools are active before an end-to-end MCP call succeeds.
